sections.name: Greeting
sections.rubric_question: Did the agent use the institutional greeting, their name and answer immediately?

score_descriptions.1: Not ready, no script, noisy headset
score_descriptions.2: Used script but poor tone, didn't pick up promptly
score_descriptions.5: Used script, great opening tone, answered immediately

sections.name: Caller ID
sections.rubric_question: Did the agent verify: full name AND DOB (OR last 4 digits of payment method OR last 4 of SSN)?

sections.name: Purpose of the Call
sections.rubric_question: Did the agent ask relevant questions to understand the issue?

score_descriptions.2: Repeated the question or asked obvious questions
score_descriptions.3: Understood but didn't probe or questions were convoluted
score_descriptions.4: Probing questions to get to root cause
score_descriptions.5: Multiple probing questions, reinstated problem back to member

sections.name: Matching the Moment
sections.rubric_question: Was tone and pace appropriate to the context of the call?

score_descriptions.4: 2 of 3: Assurance of assistance, empathy, paraphrasing
score_descriptions.5: All 3: Assurance + empathy + paraphrasing reason for call

sections.name: Process Adherence
sections.rubric_question: Did the agent follow correct process and company policies?

score_descriptions.1: Misinformed member, no action, didn't follow process
score_descriptions.2: Missing steps, incomplete info, gray areas
score_descriptions.3: Right steps but missed something minor
score_descriptions.5: Above and beyond, steps followed completely

sections.name: Call Resolution
sections.rubric_question: Was the issue fully resolved or clear resolution path provided?

score_descriptions.1: No solution provided or no follow-up
score_descriptions.3: Found solution but missed small details
score_descriptions.4: Handled call, provided resolution but missed next steps
score_descriptions.5: Solution found, educated member on process and next steps

score_descriptions.2: Landing lingo, grammatical errors, rambling, inappropriate slang
score_descriptions.5: Professional wording, clear/concise, engaging, built rapport

sections.name: Efficiency & Call Handling

score_descriptions.1: Call avoidance, inefficient hold use, didn't announce hold
score_descriptions.2: Didn't refresh member timely, wasted time finding solution
score_descriptions.3: Assisted but didn't inform caller about time needed
score_descriptions.5: No hold/dead air OR proper hold expectations set, confident throughout

sections.special_reasoning_instructions: ALWAYS include timestamps if holds longer than 3 minutes or significant dead air (longer than 30 seconds) were detected

sections.name: Human Review Required

score_descriptions.1: Reviewer agrees with the AI flag — agent handled this interaction poorly.
score_descriptions.5: Reviewer disagrees — false flag; agent handled the call well.

sections.special_reasoning_instructions: Filled by a human reviewer only when the AI trigger fires (§3.14). Default state is NA — the auto-flow never fires this section.

sections.name: Customer Resolution Indicator
sections.rubric_question: Did agent summarize result/actions AND ask if there is anything else they can do?

scoring_prompt.system_prompt_template:
You are a QA evaluator for a call center at {company}.
You will listen to a full call recording and score it using the rubric provided.

CRITICAL OUTPUT RULES:
- Return ONLY a valid JSON object. No markdown fences, no prose, no explanations outside the JSON.
- All string values must have apostrophes and internal quotes escaped.
- Never use raw newlines inside string values — use a space instead.
- The JSON must be parseable by Python json.loads() without modification.
- Use the Second person ("you") when referring to the agent in the reasoning AND feedback sections, as if you are directly addressing them with a personal tone, DO NOT use the Third person ("they/them") anywhere in your outputs.
scoring_prompt.confidence_levels_note:
- "high": Clear evidence in audio, no ambiguity
- "medium": Reasonable inference, some ambiguity or audio-dependent nuance
- "low": Insufficient signal, heavy guessing required
